'''Evgeny (Evgeniy<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://sciencejournals.ru/view-article/?j=zool&y=2021&v=100&n=8&a=Zool2108012Yubilei|title=Зоологический журнал. T. 100, Номер 8, 2021|website=sciencejournals.ru}}</ref>) Nikolayevich Panov''' ({{langx|ru|Евгений Николаевич Панов}}; 1936, in [[Moscow]]<ref name="auto">{{cite web|url=https://sciencejournals.ru/issues/zool/2021/vol_100/iss_8/Zool2108012Yubilei/Zool2108012Yubilei.pdf|title=К 85-ЛЕТИЮ ЕВГЕНИЯ НИКОЛАЕВИЧА ПАНОВА FOR THE 85TH BIRTHDAY OF EVGENIY NIKOLAEVICH PANOV (ЗООЛОГИЧЕСКИЙ ЖУРНАЛ, 2021, том 100, № 8, с. 956–960)}}</ref> – 5 August 2024)<ref>{{cite web|url=https://sev-in.ru/node/3861|title=Ушёл из жизни Евгений Николаевич Панов|work=IPEE RAS|language=ru|access-date=2 February 2025}}</ref> was a Soviet and Russian zoologist and ethologist, [[Doktor nauk|Doctor of Biological Sciences]], Professor.<ref name="auto1">{{cite web|url=https://panov-ethology.ru/images/pdf/antropology.pdf|title=ЕВГЕНИЙ ПАНОВ И АНТРОПОЛОГИЯ. ПУТЬ УЧЕНОГО}}</ref>
Laureate of the [[State Prize of the Russian Federation]] (1993).<ref name="auto1"/>
Fellow of the Russian Academy of Natural Sciences.<ref name="auto2">{{Cite web|url=https://ethology.ru/library/?id=103|title=Этология.Ру: Бегство от одиночества (Библиотека)|website=ethology.ru}}</ref>

==Career==
He graduated from the Department of Vertebrate Zoology at the [[Faculty of Biology (Moscow State University)|faculty of biology]] of the [[Lomonosov Moscow State University]] in 1959 (he was a student of [[Georgi Petrovich Dementiev]]<ref name="auto"/>). Then he worked in the [[Kedrovaya Pad Nature Reserve]]. In 1966, he defended his [[Candidate of Sciences|Candidat]] thesis.<ref name="auto"/>

He returned to Moscow in 1971. In 1973, he published his first book, «Птицы Южного Приморья».

He published in [[Znanie – Sila]].<ref name="auto2"/>
